newsitem.title: USA: Mcteer says U.S. economy at or beyond potential.
newsitem.headline: Mcteer says U.S. economy at or beyond potential.

text.p: Robert McTeer, Dallas Federal Reserve Bank president, said Thursday that the U.S. economy was running at about or even beyond its long range potential.
In remarks to a business group, Mcteer said "the U.S. economy including the southern states is operating at or beyond its long-range potential."
But he said the problem was that its potential had not been growing fast enough "due to our chronically low savings and investment rates."
